name: saga
description: Temporal's saga sample (openAccount) as a certified machine, v2: a KYC check after the bank account, with its compensation.

createAccount.why: open the account (the sample's activity, unchanged)

addAddress.why: register the postal address (the sample's activity, unchanged)

addClient.why: register the client (the sample's activity, unchanged)

addBankAccount.why: connect the bank account (the sample's activity, unchanged)

addKycCheck.why: v2: run the KYC check on the client (new step)

disconnectBankAccounts.why: compensation: undo addBankAccount (the sample's activity, unchanged)

accountId.description: the account's id; a second start for the same account attaches to the first run

unstoppable.adding_client: a step succeeded before this one: a stop would leave it un-compensated; CANCEL compensates what succeeded and ends the run
unstoppable.adding_bank: a step succeeded before this one: a stop would leave it un-compensated; CANCEL compensates what succeeded and ends the run
unstoppable.adding_kyc: a step succeeded before this one: a stop would leave it un-compensated; CANCEL compensates what succeeded and ends the run
unstoppable.undo_bank: compensating: stopping would leave the account half undone
unstoppable.undo_client: compensating: stopping would leave the account half undone
unstoppable.undo_address: compensating: stopping would leave the account half undone
